name: Pocket Sampler
description: A pocket-sampler homage: black-glass segment display, a step ring, a heart-rate fader, a seconds knob, a battery knob and a sequencer playhead across the keys.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
